cases.name: pattern-signal
cases.description: A single line is a trajectory and takes no draws
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" points="0,0 5,10 10,0" decimals="2"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pattern-smooth
cases.description: smooth eases through the points without overshooting them
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" points="0,0 5,10 10,0" decimals="2" interp="smooth"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pattern-step
cases.description: step holds each value until the next point
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" points="0,0 5,10 10,0" decimals="2" interp="step"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pattern-y-range
cases.description: y_range maps the drawing's height into real values
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" points="0,0 5,10 10,0" y_range="100..200" decimals="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pattern-spread
cases.description: spread scatters a single line into a tunnel
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" points="0,0 5,10 10,0" decimals="2" spread="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pattern-corridor
cases.description: A corridor picks a value between two lines
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" upper="0,10 10,10" lower="0,0 10,0" y_range="0..100" decimals="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pattern-density
cases.description: mode=density reads the same drawing as a distribution
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" points="0,0 5,10 10,0" y_range="0..100" decimals="1" mode="density"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pattern-averaged
cases.description: More points than rows are averaged, not sampled at one place
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" points="0,0 1,5 2,1 3,9 4,0" decimals="3"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>
